payload.title: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-001: Add GitHub integration and extensible ticket provider
payload.body:
## Summary

Introduce a `IssueProvider` (or equivalent) abstraction with a GitHub Issues implementation so the workflow can load issue title, body, and labels via the GitHub API, and document how a future Linear/Jira adapter would plug in without rewriting the core.

## Scope

- In scope: GitHub API access using `GITHUB_TOKEN` with permissions needed for issues and (for later tickets) PR read/comment; fetch issue by repo + number; architecture note with one concrete example of a future non-GitHub provider.
- Out of scope: LLM calls, acceptance-criteria parsing, posting the final AC review comment (handled in downstream tickets).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Given a PR body that references an issue (e.g. `Fixes #12`), the integration can resolve repository context and **fetch the issue body text** (and title/labels) for use by later pipeline steps.
- [ ] Permissions and required `GITHUB_TOKEN` scopes (or `permissions:` block) are **documented** for consumers of the workflow.
- [ ] An **architecture doc** (or README section) defines the `IssueProvider` interface and describes what a **Linear** (or Jira) adapter would implement; **only** the GitHub provider is registered in production code for v1.
- [ ] Code compiles/tests pass with only the GitHub provider wired in.

## Dependencies

- Depends on: none
- Blocks: GHA-PR-LLM-AC-003, GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005

## Notes

Align with PRD §5 (inputs: PR metadata, diff) — fetching **PR metadata and diff** may live in this module or be added alongside it so GHA-PR-LLM-AC-005 does not duplicate API clients; pick one place and reference it from dependent tickets.

PRD: https://github.com/hyperjumptech/mediapulse/blob/prds/pr-github-llm-ticket-acceptance.prd.md
